facts.detail: Add two cloves into the grinding bowl.
Add a small piece of fresh ginger.
Crush all the dry spices together thoroughly.
Slice open a date and remove its pit.
Stuff the crushed spice mixture inside the pitted date.
Submerge the stuffed date in pure honey overnight.
Eat in the morning to eliminate fatigue and boost physical stamina naturally.
